blurb: The museum is located on the grounds of College Park Airport and showcases the history, innovation, and enterprise of the 'Field of Firsts.' It offers exhibits, educational programming, and special events for all ages. Guided tours are available for groups of ten or more, lasting approximately 45 minutes to an hour.
